ReplacementContent:
"                          {/* New Order Button */}
                          <button

                            className="bg-[#1a2530] hover:bg-[#2c3e50] text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-extrabold transition-all"
                          >
                            New Order
                          </button>"
